items.claim: Google personalized advertising restricts targeting users based on sensitive interest categories and states ads should not target users in ways that exploit personal hardships.

Google treats content related to abuse and trauma as a sensitive interest category; advertiser-curated audiences cannot be used when promoting in that category, while some predefined Google audiences may still be used.
Meta ads must not assert or imply personal attributes, including disability, physical or mental health including medical conditions, or vulnerable financial status.
Meta requires US-targeting financial products, housing, or employment ads to self-identify as a Special Ad Category when that framework applies.

Prediction: PI search campaigns that stay on keyword and location intent and avoid remarketing lists built from injury-page visitors are less likely to collide with Google sensitive-category audience rules than list-based remarketing.
